name: Cement

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: 2Q operating performance in line; high fuel cost leads to margin pressure
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Aggregate volumes for coverage grew ~8% YoY to 107mt (+1% vs estimates) and realisation rose ~3% YoY to INR5,618/t (+1% QoQ). Gross margin dipped 1.7pp YoY to ~57% as ~7% higher variable cost per tonne outpaced the ~3% realisation gain; total opex/t rose ~6% to INR4,838. Aggregate EBITDA fell ~5% YoY to INR88.4b (+3% vs estimates), OPM contracted 2.7pp to ~14% and average EBITDA/t fell ~14% YoY to INR780 (5% above estimates); PAT rose ~38% YoY to INR54.7b. Guidance: demand healthy with profitability expected to improve in 2HFY27; UltraTech evaluating expansion beyond 240mtpa by FY28; Shree guides 40-41mt FY27 volume (10-13% growth); Dalmia Bharat's capacity to reach 67mtpa by FY28-end. No rating changes.

unit_economics: EBITDA = volume x (grey realisation/t - power and fuel/t - freight/t - raw material/t - employee/t - other/t) + incentives; volume = capacity x utilisation, and fixed costs per tonne fall with utilisation.

price_drivers.why: Realisation less fuel and freight per tonne drives profit; average EBITDA/t fell ~14% YoY to INR780 in 2QFY27 on fuel cost.

price_drivers.driver: Regional price discipline and hike retention
price_drivers.why: Prices are set regionally; price stayed broadly stable QoQ in 2Q and only a fraction of announced hikes sticks when leaders chase volume.

price_drivers.driver: Fuel and freight cost (petcoke, coal, diesel)
price_drivers.why: Variable cost per tonne rose ~7% YoY; imported petcoke reaches the P&L in 60-90 days.
Leaders adding 240mtpa-plus (UltraTech) and 132mt industry adds over FY27-29 cap utilisation near 72-73%.
Government-led infra and housing drove ~8% volume growth; volume leverage dilutes fixed cost.

kpis.name: EBITDA per tonne (reported and clean grey)
kpis.definition: Operating EBITDA divided by tonnes sold, with a house version excluding incentives, other income, non-grey segments and one-offs.
kpis.formula: EBITDA / sales volume (Rs/t); clean = (EBITDA - incentives - non-grey - one-offs) / grey tonnes
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Sector EV/EBITDA is applied to EBITDA/t trend; INR780/t versus INR903-1,072/t a year earlier explains the margin-driven de-rating, and each INR100/t is ~INR10.7b of quarterly sector EBITDA at 107mt.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'EBITDA per tonne' (UltraTech, Ambuja, Dalmia, JK, Ramco, Nuvoco decks); get_financials for EBITDA and revenue; Motilal Oswal results tables carry 8 quarters of EBITDA/t.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates gives Bloomberg EBITDA; divide by broker volume forecasts for EBITDA/t (no consensus field); company guidance from transcripts.
kpis.traps: Denominators differ (Nuvoco incl. RMC over cement tonnes, JSW incl. GGBS, JK grey plus white); Ambuja and ACC deck restatements; incentives inside other operating income.

kpis.name: Grey cement realisation per tonne and regional dealer prices
kpis.definition: Net grey revenue per tonne after GST, discounts and rebates, tracked against regional dealer price changes.
kpis.formula: Grey cement revenue (ex incentives) / grey tonnes
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Price is the largest swing factor in EBITDA/t: Rs10 per bag is Rs200/t, roughly 17% of UltraTech FY26 EBITDA; hikes sticking for two rounds re-rates the sector, failed rounds de-rate it.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'realisation'; get_financials revenue and volume; Motilal Oswal tables (INR5,618/t aggregate in 2QFY27); broker monthly channel-check notes in the library (JM, Nomura, Kotak).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field for price; broker models and sector notes; company statements on hike sequencing in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Dealer-price levels differ by GST basis and trade/non-trade (use changes); GST cut 22-Sep-25 breaks per-bag series; NSR including incentives (Dalmia).

kpis.name: Volume growth and utilisation
kpis.definition: Domestic grey tonnes growth, organic versus acquired, versus industry production and average commercial capacity.
kpis.formula: Grey tonnes / prior-year tonnes - 1; tonnes / average grinding capacity
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Volume above industry (~8% in 2Q) earns share and dilutes fixed cost; fixed cost/t rises for companies with flat volume, widening the EBITDA/t gap to leaders.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'volume' and 'utilisation'; Motilal Oswal tables; transcripts for guidance (Shree 40-41mt FY27).
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance in transcripts; broker models; get_consensus_estimates Sales as an output check.
kpis.traps: Intra-group MSA sales inflate Ambuja/ACC gross volume; acquisitions (Kesoram, India Cements) restate growth; ex-works versus FOR basis.

kpis.name: Power and fuel cost per tonne (and fuel Rs per '000 kcal)
kpis.definition: Power and fuel cost over tonnes sold, with fuel cost per thousand kcal and mix.
kpis.formula: Power and fuel cost / tonnes; fuel Rs/'000 kcal
kpis.why_it_moves_price: High petcoke drove the 2QFY27 margin hit: variable cost/t +7% YoY. Fuel above Rs2.0 per '000 kcal marks a shock regime; Rs0.10 is about Rs40-50/t.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'fuel cost' and 'power and fuel'; get_financials power and fuel line; get_commodity_prices for petcoke and coal; transcripts for fuel inventory days.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; house view from get_commodity_prices forward curve and management cost guidance in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Labels (Rs/kcal, Rs/Mcal) all mean per thousand kcal; kiln-only versus captive power included; production-basis versus sold-basis costs.

kpis.name: Freight cost per tonne and lead distance
kpis.definition: Freight and forwarding cost over tonnes, with lead distance and rail share.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Freight is ~31% of cost; 2QFY27 freight/t rose ~1% YoY, a smaller contributor than fuel, but diesel and rail surcharges move it ~Rs38/t per Rs7.5/litre.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'freight' or 'lead distance'; get_financials freight and forwarding line.
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance in transcripts; broker models; no consensus.
kpis.traps: Ex-works switch lowers realisation and freight together; clinker transfers inside freight.

kpis.name: State incentives per tonne
kpis.definition: Capital subsidy and SGST refunds booked in other operating income, per grey tonne.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Incentives of Rs0-450/t sit inside EBITDA; scheme expiry or GST-linked cuts reduce earnings with no volume change, so they must be valued as NPV not at the sector multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_financials other operating income; annual reports in the library (read_library_document); transcripts for amounts (call-only for most).
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models only; company guidance in transcripts; no Bloomberg field.
kpis.traps: Prior-period catch-ups; Dalmia NSR includes incentives; West Bengal scheme revocation.

kpis.name: Capex per tonne, net debt/EBITDA and RoCE
kpis.definition: Project cost per tonne of added capacity, leverage and pre-tax RoCE on capital ex CWIP.
kpis.formula: Project capex / tonnes added; net debt / EBITDA; EBIT / average capital employed
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Expansion beyond 240mtpa (UltraTech) and brownfield USD50-80/t versus M&A at USD57-98/t sets return on new capital; leverage stretches de-rate mid-caps.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'capex' and 'net debt'; get_financials balance sheet and cash flow; transcripts for project dates.
kpis.estimate_source: Management capex guidance in transcripts; broker models; get_consensus_estimates for EPS only.
kpis.traps: Capacity under trial counted early; goodwill and acquisition step-ups in capital employed; USD versus INR conversion.

macro_inputs.series: OEA cement production index; dealer price checks
macro_inputs.source: Broker monthly notes in the library; OEA outside Airavat

valuation_anchor: EV/EBITDA on 1-year forward clean EBITDA against own post-FY21 band, with EV/tonne of capacity versus replacement cost (USD120-125/t) and M&A EV/t as cross-checks.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, managements expect profitability to improve in 2HFY27: track hike retention against fuel cost, UltraTech's expansion decision beyond 240mtpa, Shree's 40-41mt volume guide, Dalmia's capacity ramp and Grasim's paints investments pressuring margin.
